title: Cheque dates and positive-pay checks - support procedure
content: For a synthetic enquiry, ask a demo agent to check the configured date and verification requirements before presentment. Exact validity periods, thresholds and penalties must be confirmed from the relevant institution rather than invented by the assistant.
